brief:
Al-Mamadani Hospital in Gaza faces the threat of halting operations, according to the Ma'an news agency. The facility confronts challenges that could force it to cease functioning, though the specific circumstances threatening its closure remain unspecified in initial reporting.

The hospital's potential shutdown would compound the strain on Gaza's already-decimated healthcare system, which has faced severe constraints on fuel, medical supplies, and staffing throughout the conflict.
title: Gaza's al-Mamadani hospital faces shutdown
